confirmation.interpretation: Correct-count margin is the primary effect-size readout. Confidence intervals and sign-flip p-values are retained, but the diagnostic ranking is based on the sealed mean effect. Grammar strata have only 10/5 seeds and are explicitly diagnostic rather than separate formal 20/10 experiments.
